battle.name: 第七次俄土戰爭
battle.theater: 魯塞（保加利亞多瑙河下游）
battle.brief: 第七次俄土戰爭是中文維基「戰爭列表」中的俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖魯帝國戰爭，1806年爆發，延至1812年，交戰重點在多瑙河下游、黑海北岸及高加索。英國陸軍的燧發槍（Flintlock musket）於1710年服役，屬當時步兵火器體系，也是步兵編制中的通用火器，並用於野戰。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 這場戰爭就是通常所稱的第七次俄土戰爭，延續於1806年至1812年，正式交戰者為俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖曼帝國。俄軍以比薩拉比亞、普魯特河及多瑙河下游為主要基地，鄂軍則依托瓦拉齊亞、摩爾多瓦，以及魯塞克、錫利斯特拉等要塞。塞爾維亞戰區在1810年後成為第二條主要戰線。英國與法國不是正式參戰方，卻分別以貸款、武器和外交支持介入鄂方與俄方的交涉。全戰可分為三段：1806年鄂軍越過多瑙河、俄軍退守普魯特河；1807年俄軍渡河包圍錫利斯特拉，並在魯塞克擊敗鄂軍援軍，隨後簽訂斯洛博齊亞休戰；1810年戰事重啟，1811年魯塞克陷落，最後以1812年的布加勒斯特條約收束。因此，1806年是開戰年份，而不是整場戰爭的終點。
countriesEn: This conflict was the generally designated Seventh Russo-Turkish War, which lasted from 1806 to 1812 between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. The Russians based themselves principally in Bessarabia, along the Prut, and in the Lower Danube, while the Ottoman forces drew upon Wallachia, Moldavia, and fortresses such as Ruse and Silistra. Serbia became a second major theater after 1810. Britain and France were not formal belligerents, but they intervened through loans, weapons, and diplomatic support for the opposing parties. The war unfolded in three phases: Ottoman crossings of the Danube and the Russian fallback to the Prut in 1806; the Russian crossing of the Danube, siege of Silistra, and defeat of the Ottoman relief army at Ruse in 1807, followed by the Truce of Slobozia; and the resumption of hostilities in 1810, the fall of Ruse in 1811, and the settlement in the Treaty of Bucharest in 1812. Thus, 1806 was the year hostilities began, not the conclusion of the entire war.
people: 俄國由皇帝亞歷山大一世主持戰局，亞歷克謝·阿拉克切耶夫負責中央軍政，但真正決定前線節奏的是一批經驗不同的將領。1806年，姆尼爾·卡缅斯基最初統率駐摩爾多瓦的俄軍，米洛拉多維奇指揮前出支隊；由於部隊分散、命令失配及前進速度受糧秣限制，卡缅斯基在同年由伊萬·古多維奇接替。古多維奇把作戰重心轉向多瑙河下游與要塞攻取，彼得·巴格拉蒂昂則在1807年率機動部隊投入魯塞克方向。1810年，尼古拉·卡缅斯基率軍進入塞爾維亞，扎哈里·切尔尼舍夫在瓦爾瓦林指揮前衛戰，翌年庫圖佐夫接掌多瑙河軍，負責封鎖魯塞克及迎擊鄂軍援軍。鄂方先由塞利姆三世執政，1808年馬哈茂二世即位後繼續戰事；優素福帕夏率援軍赴錫利斯特拉，艾哈邁德帕夏在瓦爾瓦林戰敗，哈吉·哈利勒帕夏與科賈優素福帕夏則在1811年主持塞爾維亞和魯塞克方面的作戰。俄軍以步兵團、龍騎兵團、哥薩克騎兵、砲兵、工兵及舟橋分隊組成軍團；鄂軍由尼尚吉步兵、各省軍隊、騎兵與托普曲砲兵臨時集中，兩個體系的指揮速度與後勤標準並不相同。
peopleEn: Russia's emperor Alexander I directed the war at the center, with Alexander Arakcheev supervising the military administration, but the operational rhythm on the Danube was determined by generals with very different backgrounds. In 1806, Mikhail Kamensky initially commanded the Russian forces in Moldavia while Miloradovich led the forward detachments. Because the columns were dispersed, commands arrived out of sequence, and their advance was limited by food and ammunition, Kamensky was replaced during the year by Ivan Gudovich. Gudovich shifted the focus toward the Lower Danube and the reduction of fortresses, while Peter Bagration committed mobile forces to the Ruse sector in 1807. In 1810, Nikolay Kamensky led the Russian entry into Serbia, Zakhary Chernyshev commanded the advance at Varvarin, and Kutuzov took command of the Danube Army in the following year to blockade Ruse and meet the Ottoman relief. Selim III governed the Ottoman side at the outbreak, while Mahmud II continued the war after his accession in 1808. Yusuf Pasha conducted the relief of Silistra, Ahmed Pasha was defeated at Varvarin, and Hacı Halil Pasha and Koca Yusuf Pasha directed operations in Serbia and around Ruse in 1811. Russian formations combined infantry regiments, dragoon regiments, Cossack cavalry, artillery, engineers, and pontoon detachments into corps. The Ottoman field army was assembled from nişancı infantry, provincial regiments, cavalry, and topçu artillery; the two systems consequently operated with different command tempos and logistical standards.
kits: 至1806年，俄軍步兵主要使用1796式燧發滑膛步槍，龍騎兵及部分騎兵使用1797式卡賓槍，兩者均早於本戰爭列裝，並非戰時新造的武器。軍官配燧發手槍，騎兵配馬刀，哥薩克另有長矛、彎刀及卡賓槍；步兵的刺刀、槍彈盒、藥包、背囊和野戰炊具共同構成行軍負荷。俄軍砲兵使用一普特獨角獸砲以及六磅、十磅野戰砲，攻堅時則徵用口徑更大的攻城砲；野戰砲配實心彈和霰彈，攻城單位備有炸彈。鄂軍至遲在1806年已普遍裝備燧發滑膛步槍、卡賓槍、刺刀、馬刀與手槍，尼尚吉和各省步兵的火力同樣依賴黑火藥。托普曲砲兵使用三磅、六磅、十二磅野戰砲，較大的攻城砲則部署於固定 siege positions，並配備實心彈、霰彈和炸彈。俄軍以藥包供應步兵裝藥，砲隊則由彈藥車和沿多瑙河、普魯特河輸送的船隻補充火藥與彈丸；鄂軍也依靠多瑙河船運、河堡倉儲和陸路彈藥隊。俄軍在進軍塞爾維亞時還攜帶舟橋分隊、帳篷、炊具和野戰醫療箱。無論何方，砲彈重量、飼料消耗和彈藥車速度都會限制追擊距離，渡河點後方的倉站因此與戰鬥本身同樣重要。
kitsEn: By 1806 the Russian infantry principally carried the Model 1796 flintlock smoothbore musket, while dragoons and some other cavalry units used the Model 1797 carbine. Both weapons had entered service before the war and were not late-war improvisations. Officers carried flintlock pistols, cavalrymen carried sabres, and Cossacks also had lances, curved sabres, and carbines. Infantry bayonets, cartridge boxes, charge packets, knapsacks, and field cooking equipment together formed the marching load. Russian artillery used one-pood unicorns and six- and ten-pounder field guns, while larger siege cannon was drawn into fortress operations. Field batteries carried round shot and canister, and siege units also held bombs. The Ottoman army already had flintlock smoothbore muskets, carbines, bayonets, sabres, and pistols in widespread service among the nişancı and provincial infantry. Topçu batteries fielded three-, six-, and twelve-pounder guns, while heavier siege pieces were placed in fixed positions with round shot, canister, and bombs. The Russians supplied infantry ammunition in charge packets and moved artillery powder and shot by ammunition wagons and by river transport on the Danube and Prut. The Ottomans likewise used river craft, magazines in Danube fortresses, and land ammunition columns. When the Russians advanced into Serbia, they also brought pontoon detachments, tents, field kitchens, and medical boxes. On both sides, the weight of shot, consumption of fodder, and speed of the ammunition wagons limited the distance of pursuit; rear-area depots around crossing points were therefore as important as the fighting itself.
tactics: 1806年的第一階段以多瑙河渡口和糧秣線為核心。俄曆五月二十四日，即新曆六月五日，俄羅斯宣戰後，鄂軍在六月分批渡過多瑙河，向瓦拉齊亞和摩爾多瓦推進。俄軍沒有在兩個公國內的每一條道路上分兵應戰，而是放棄部分遠離後方的據點，轉向普魯特河收縮。六月在欣切什蒂、七月在列瓦、八月在特斯卡尼、九月在雷姆等地接戰，另有兵力在布加勒斯特方向交鋒；米洛拉多維奇所率支隊以騎兵、砲兵和較集中的步兵應付鄂軍多路滲透。鄂軍雖能利用俄軍最初分散的軍團，卻未能把數個縱隊立即轉成對普魯特河防線的包圍，原因在縱隊間距離、渡口使用及彈藥補給不統一。俄軍的撤退使瓦拉齊亞和摩爾多瓦大部一度落入鄂方控制，卻保存了主力。卡缅斯基被古多維奇接替後，俄軍把防禦重點放在普魯特河渡口與比薩拉比亞倉站，避免鄂軍以縱深作戰拖垮補給。到1806年秋，雙方實際形成鄂軍控制多瑙河以西，俄軍控制普魯特河與比薩拉比亞的格局。此時決定戰局的不是奪取一座都城，而是誰能維持渡河、運彈和連續供應。
tacticsEn: The opening phase centered on the Danube crossings and the lines of supply. After Russia declared war on 24 May Old Style, or 5 June New Style, Ottoman forces crossed the Danube in several groups during June and advanced into Wallachia and Moldavia. Rather than fighting on every road inside the two principalities, the Russians relinquished exposed positions and contracted toward the Prut. Fighting occurred at Hîncești in June, Leova in July, Tescani in August, and Rym in September, while other detachments engaged near the approaches to Bucharest. Miloradovich used cavalry, artillery, and comparatively concentrated infantry against several Ottoman penetrations. The Ottomans exploited the initial separation of the Russian corps but could not immediately convert their columns into an encirclement of the Prut line because the marching columns, crossings, and ammunition depots were not synchronized. The Russian withdrawal gave the Ottomans control over most of Wallachia and Moldavia but preserved the field army. After Gudovich replaced Kamensky, the Russians concentrated on Prut crossings and depots in Bessarabia rather than allowing pursuit into terrain that would stretch their supply. By autumn 1806 the operational pattern was an Ottoman grip on the Danube side and a Russian hold on the Prut and Bessarabia. The issue was no longer the capture of a capital; it was which army could keep crossings, ammunition, and supply moving.
data: 1807年五、六月間，古多維奇率俄軍利用舟橋在布尤克德雷一帶渡過多瑙河，包圍錫利斯特拉，並把攻城砲、糧食和彈藥運過河。鄂軍優素福帕夏率援軍沿多瑙河南岸向魯塞克方向接近，試圖解除錫利斯特拉之圍。1807年7月4日的魯塞克戰鬥中，巴格拉蒂昂率機動部隊攻擊援軍，砲兵和騎兵在通往魯塞克及通往錫利斯特拉的道路上切斷其聯絡；鄂軍退入城區與要塞體系，俄軍則占據魯塞克，使錫利斯特拉的陸路補給更加困難。戰役沒有立即形成對整個鄂軍的決定性包圍，但改變了鄂方必須應對的優先次序。1807年7月24日，新曆8月5日，俄鄂代表在斯洛博齊亞簽訂休戰。俄軍停止進攻並退出瓦拉齊亞、摩爾多瓦的大部分占區，鄂方也停止追擊；比薩拉比亞仍由俄方控制，鄂軍則重新占據兩個公國。休戰之後，《提爾西特條約》與其後的法俄外交安排限制俄國直接援助塞爾維亞起義軍，鄂軍則利用這段時間整頓多瑙河防務。休戰期於1810年屆滿，雙方在塞爾維亞和多瑙河下游重新開戰，因此1807年是戰爭的戰術轉折與外交停滯，而不是全戰終止。
dataEn: In May and June 1807 Gudovich crossed the Danube with his pontoon train near Büyükdere, invested Silistra, and moved siege cannon, provisions, and ammunition across the river. Yusuf Pasha marched a relief army along the southern bank toward Ruse in an effort to raise the siege. At the battle of Ruse on 4 July 1807, Bagration's mobile force struck the relief column, while Russian artillery and cavalry cut its communications toward both Ruse and Silistra. The Ottoman forces withdrew into the city and its fortress system, and the Russians occupied Ruse, placing further pressure on Silistra's land communications. The action did not at once produce a decisive encirclement of the entire Ottoman army, but it changed the Porte's order of priorities. On 24 July, or 5 August New Style, representatives of Russia and the Ottoman Empire signed the Truce of Slobozia. Russia stopped its offensive and withdrew from most of the occupied parts of Wallachia and Moldavia, while the Ottomans ceased their pursuit; Bessarabia remained under Russian control, and the Ottoman forces reoccupied the principalities. After the truce, the Treaty of Tilsit and subsequent Franco-Russian arrangements constrained direct Russian support for the Serbian insurgents, while the Ottomans used the interval to reorganize the Danube defenses. The truce expired in 1810, and fighting resumed in Serbia and along the Lower Danube. Thus, 1807 was both an operational turning point and a diplomatic pause, not the end of the war.
cause: 戰爭源於俄國與鄂圖曼帝國在黑海、達達尼爾海門戶及多瑙河公國問題上的權力衝突。十九世紀初法國革命戰爭改變了歐洲力量關係，俄國在比薩拉比亞的據守已使它在西北方向取得戰略縱深，鄂圖曼朝廷則要恢復對瓦拉齊亞與摩爾多瓦的完整控制。塞爾維亞起義又使鄂方無法把全部兵力留在多瑙河東岸。1806年初，鄂方撤換受俄國支持、實際由俄方影響的瓦拉齊亞 hospodar 康斯坦丁·伊普西蘭蒂和摩爾多瓦 hospodar 亞歷山德羅·莫魯濟，限制俄國商船使用博斯普魯斯海峽與達達尼爾海峽，並重新處理俄國在兩公國的軍事及商業權利。法國在君士坦丁堡的外交支持和英國對鄂方的財政援助，使鄂廷相信可以迫使聖彼得堡讓步；俄國則把撤換 hospodar、限制海峽和削弱俄方既有地位視為不能再容忍的變化。聖彼得堡要求保障俄船通行、恢復可合作的地方行政並維持俄國在多瑙河的安全界線，鄂方不接受，雙方又都不肯先撤回要求。俄羅斯遂於1806年5月24日宣戰。由此引發的並非一場偶然邊界衝突，而是地方統治權、海峽航運、駐軍權利及黑海安全相互交疊所形成的戰爭。
causeEn: The war arose from a clash over the Black Sea, the Turkish Straits, and authority in the Danubian principalities. The French Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars had altered the European balance. Russian occupation of Bessarabia gave St Petersburg strategic depth on its northwestern frontier, while the Ottoman government sought to restore effective control over Wallachia and Moldavia. The Serbian uprising made it impossible for the Porte to leave every soldier on the eastern bank of the Danube. In early 1806 the Ottomans replaced Constantine Ypsilanti in Wallachia and Alexandros Moruzi in Moldavia, both of whom were supported and influenced by Russia; restricted Russian merchant shipping through the Bosporus and the Dardanelles; and altered Russian military and commercial privileges in the principalities. French diplomatic backing in Constantinople and British financial assistance to the Porte encouraged the Ottoman government to demand Russian concessions. St Petersburg regarded the removal of the hospodars, the restriction of the Straits, and the weakening of established Russian positions as intolerable. Russian demands centered on secure navigation, a workable local administration, and a defensible frontier along the Danube. The Porte refused, and neither side was prepared to withdraw its demands. Russia therefore declared war on 24 May 1806. The result was not an accidental frontier clash but a war produced by the overlapping questions of local rulership, straits navigation, military rights, and Black Sea security.
impact: 戰爭最直接的長期影響，是塞爾維亞自治地位得到外部承認。塞爾維亞起義軍及後來的俄羅斯遠征擴大了自治機關，1812年條約把這種地位置於蘇丹宗主權之下確認，但它不是完整國家獨立。鄂圖曼帝國承受財政與軍令分散的壓力，1808年馬哈茂二世即位後，朝廷一面處理塞爾維亞問題，一面整頓省軍和砲兵；這場戰爭沒有摧毀鄂方，反而促使其中央集權問題更受注意。俄國則取得比薩拉比亞及布賈克，形成以普魯特河為界的新北方邊界，卻也暴露了遠征多瑙河時補給線過長、砲兵與步兵協同困難等問題。1810至1811年的勝利使俄軍得以由塞爾維亞戰線調回，因此當拿破崙在1812年進入波蘭方面時，俄軍正把部分兵力與指揮重心轉向西線；這項時間安排提高了俄國應付西部的能力，卻不能被解釋為俄國控制了拿破崙的決策。英國以貸款和武器援助鄂方，也加深俄英之間的戒心；俄國在提爾西特體系下與法國接近，則同時具有外交與軍事上的現實原因。整體而言，戰爭改善了俄國在比薩拉比亞與多瑙河上游的位置，擴大了塞爾維亞的自治空間，並使鄂圖曼帝國的財政及中央改革問題更加迫切。
impactEn: The most direct long-term effect was international recognition of Serbian autonomy. The Serbian insurgent forces and the subsequent Russian expedition enlarged the autonomous institutions, and the treaty of 1812 confirmed that position under the Sultan's sovereignty, but it did not create full statehood. The Ottoman Empire faced pressure on both public finances and command cohesion. After Mahmud II came to the throne in 1808, the government had to manage the Serbian question while reorganizing provincial troops and artillery. The war did not destroy the Ottoman state; it instead made the weaknesses of central control more prominent. Russia acquired Bessarabia and Budjak, establishing a new northern frontier along the Prut, but the Danube campaigns also exposed the difficulty of supporting distant operations and coordinating artillery with infantry. The victories of 1810 and 1811 allowed Russian forces to leave the Serbian theater, so that when Napoleon entered the Polish theater in 1812, part of the Russian army and command attention was shifting west. The timing increased Russia's ability to meet the western danger, although it did not mean that Russia controlled Napoleon's decisions. British loans and weapons for the Porte also deepened Russo-British mistrust, while Russia's rapprochement with France after Tilsit had both diplomatic and military reasons. In strategic terms, the war strengthened Russia in Bessarabia and the upper Danube, enlarged the sphere of Serbian autonomy, and made the Ottoman fiscal and constitutional problems more urgent.
result: 最後一役始於1810年。俄軍在尼古拉·卡缅斯基指揮下越過多瑙河進入鄂方塞爾維亞，9月5日的瓦爾瓦林戰鬥中，札哈里·切尔尼舍夫率前衛部隊擊敗艾哈邁德帕夏；9月16日俄軍取得巴廷，10月19日占領尼什，與塞爾維亞起義軍共同壓縮了鄂方在莫拉瓦河上游的控制。1811年夏，亞歷山德羅沃及阿萊克西納茨方向再交戰，庫圖佐夫接掌多瑙河軍後，轉而封鎖魯塞克。科賈優素福帕夏率援軍試圖解圍，卻在9月27日舊曆、即10月9日新曆的斯洛博齊亞戰鬥中受挫；10月23日，魯塞克守軍在援軍失敗、糧食及彈藥供應受限的情況下投降，鄂方在多瑙河南岸的堡壘體系隨之瓦解。拿破崙於1812年5月進入波蘭方面後，俄國不宜再把主力留在南方，兩國遂於5月16日舊曆、5月28日新曆簽訂布加勒斯特條約。俄國保留並正式取得比薩拉比亞與布賈克，交還所占的瓦拉齊亞、摩爾多瓦及塞爾維亞領土，鄂方則承認塞爾維亞在蘇丹統治下的自治地位。對俄國而言，保障比薩拉比亞、削弱鄂方在塞爾維亞的軍事控制及打開多瑙河下游戰略空間的目標均告達成；對鄂圖曼帝國而言，兩個多瑙河公國仍獲保存，蘇丹對塞爾維亞的名義宗主權亦獲條約確認，但比薩拉比亞的喪失與塞爾維亞自治的確認是明確而長久的損失。這是一場沒有推翻鄂方、卻使俄國在南俄邊界取得實質增益的有限戰爭。
resultEn: The final campaign began in 1810. Under Nikolay Kamensky, Russian troops crossed the Danube and entered Ottoman-held Serbia. At Varvarin on 5 September, Zakhary Chernyshev's advanced detachment defeated Ahmed Pasha. The Russians took Batin on 16 September and Niš on 19 October, working with the Serbian insurgents to compress Ottoman control in the upper Morava valley. Fighting resumed in the Aleksinac and Aleksandrovo sectors in the summer of 1811. Kutuzov then assumed command of the Danube Army and shifted the effort to the blockade of Ruse. Koca Yusuf Pasha attempted to relieve the fortress but was defeated at Slobozia on 27 September Old Style, or 9 October New Style. On 23 October, with the relief defeated and food and ammunition supplies severely constrained, the garrison of Ruse surrendered, and the Ottoman defensive system along the southern bank of the Danube began to collapse. After Napoleon entered the Polish theater in May 1812, Russia could no longer afford to keep the bulk of its army in the south. The two powers consequently signed the Treaty of Bucharest on 16 May Old Style, or 28 May New Style. Russia retained and formally annexed Bessarabia and Budjak, returned its occupied territories in Wallachia, Moldavia, and Serbia, and the Ottomans recognized Serbian autonomy under the Sultan's authority. Russia had achieved its immediate objectives of securing Bessarabia, weakening Ottoman military control in Serbia, and gaining a strategic approach to the Lower Danube. The Ottomans preserved both Danubian principalities and the Sultan's nominal sovereignty over Serbia, but the loss of Bessarabia and confirmation of Serbian autonomy were substantial and lasting changes. The result was not the overthrow of the Ottoman Empire, but a limited war that gave Russia concrete strategic gains along its southern frontier.
